meta.title: RideShare LLC — Rides across Montreal
meta.description: RideShare LLC connects riders and drivers across Montreal, from the Plateau to Trudeau Airport. Book a ride in minutes, in English or French.

hero.title: Every borough. Every hour. One tap away.
hero.subtitle: RideShare LLC moves Montrealers across the island — reliable cars, upfront prices in dollars, and bilingual drivers who know the city.

items.title: Upfront prices
items.text: See the full fare — taxes included — before you confirm. No surprises on Sainte-Catherine.

items.title: Island-wide coverage
items.text: From Verdun to Hochelaga, Mile End to LaSalle, and every terminal at Trudeau Airport.

items.title: Bilingual by default
items.text: Ride in the language you're comfortable in. Nos chauffeurs parlent français et anglais.

items.title: Winter-ready drivers
items.text: All-season tires, winter-tested cars, and drivers who know how to handle the 40 in a snowstorm.

steps.title: Set your route
steps.text: Pick a pickup and drop-off point from Montreal's landmarks, stations, and neighbourhoods.

steps.title: Confirm your fare
steps.text: Choose RideShare, Comfort or XL, see the exact price, and confirm in one tap.

steps.title: Ride and arrive
steps.text: Track your driver live, hop in, and pay automatically when you get out. Rate the trip after.

safety.title: Safety you can feel
safety.text: Every RideShare LLC driver is background-checked, insured, and rated after each trip. Share your trip status with family and friends in one tap.

drive.title: Earn on your schedule
drive.text: Own a car and know Montreal? Drive with RideShare LLC. Keep 78% of every fare, get paid weekly, and choose your own hours.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.shareNote: You keep 78% of every fare. Payouts arrive every Monday by direct deposit.

pricing.title: Simple, upfront pricing
pricing.subtitle: No surge surprises, no hidden fees. Prices in Canadian dollars.

notes.taxes: All fares include 5% GST and 9.975% QST.
notes.airport: A $12 fee applies to trips starting or ending at Trudeau Airport (YUL).
notes.rush: A 25% peak-time adjustment applies on weekdays, 7–9 AM and 4–6 PM.
notes.cancellation: Cancellations are free before your driver arrives at the pickup point.

safetyPage.title: Safety first, always
safetyPage.subtitle: Getting home safely is the whole point.

items.title: Vetted drivers
items.text: Every driver passes a background check, a driving record review, and a vehicle inspection before their first trip.

items.title: Live trip sharing
items.text: Share your live location, driver details, and plate number with friends or family while you ride.

items.title: Rated after every trip
items.text: Both riders and drivers rate each trip. Consistently low ratings remove drivers from the platform.

items.title: 24/7 support
items.text: Our Montreal support team answers in French and English, any hour of the night.

howPage.title: How RideShare works
howPage.subtitle: From tap to destination in four steps.

steps.title: Open the app
steps.text: Tell us where you're picked up and where you're going. We know Montreal's landmarks, metros, and arenas.

steps.title: See your price
steps.text: Fares are calculated from distance, time, and the ride type you choose — with taxes already included.

steps.title: Meet your driver
steps.text: Watch your driver approach in real time, with the car model, colour, and plate shown up front.

steps.title: Hop out and go
steps.text: Payment happens automatically. Keep the receipt, rate the trip, and you're on your way.

drivePage.title: Turn your car into income
drivePage.subtitle: Drive with RideShare LLC across Montreal and the surrounding regions.

requirements.title: What you need
items: A valid Quebec driver's licence (Class 5 or higher)
A 2015 or newer vehicle, in good winter shape
A clean driving record and background check

earningsBox.title: What you can earn
earningsBox.text: Drivers keep 78% of every fare. A typical evening shift of six downtown rides earns:
earningsBox.exampleNote: before gas and expenses, based on average October trips
earningsBox.weekly: and weekly direct deposits, every Monday

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Send your details and car information — it takes two minutes.

steps.title: Get approved
steps.text: We check your licence, record, and vehicle. Most drivers are approved within 48 hours.

steps.title: Start earning
steps.text: Go online whenever you want, from wherever you are on the island.
